title: The bird on the mailbox
logline: The roadside mailbox in December, flag down, and the bird on the flag. Twenty days before the flag goes up. The page doesn't connect them.

panels.composition: A roadside mailbox in December drizzle with its red flag down and the small rainbow bird perched on the flag, the wet road, a porch light far back.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a roadside mailbox in December drizzle with its red flag down and a small rainbow bird perched on the lowered flag, a wet road and a distant porch light, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
